energy_paired_difference.description: paired difference of retrieval/matching energy; a NEGATIVE value means the arm is better (lower energy).

gap_paired_difference.description: paired difference of a modality gap / centroid distance; the gap has no monotone health meaning for classification (neutral).

accuracy_paired_difference.description: paired difference of accuracy / top-1 / F1: a POSITIVE value means the arm is better.

energy paired difference.note: P3 residual: a negative paired difference (-3570.10) is BETTER, not 'opposite'.
